name: Next Up Cleanup
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up, so the row only holds shows you are actually watching. Filters the server's response, changes no watch data.
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started.

versions.changelog: Filters the combined Continue Watching / Next Up home row, which 1.0.0.0 missed: the Continue Watching endpoints and any Home Screen Sections section are now covered, not just /Shows/NextUp. On a combined row only untouched first episodes are hidden, so an episode you are part-way through never disappears. Routes behind a reverse proxy base path are matched too, and every filtered row is logged at debug level.

Initial release: filters the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up, on every client, without touching any watch data. Two modes - hide every S01E01, or keep the ones that already have a resume position or a play date. Requests are over-fetched and trimmed so the row stays as long as the client asked for.
